_comment: Pre-redesign portfolio baseline captured from src/pages/PortfolioPage.tsx (now src/content/projects.js). Array order is significant: the carousel index arithmetic and the 'Project {i+1} of {n}' announcement depend on it. `image` records the asset filename, not the bundled module path, so the fixture stays stable across builds. `available: false` means the project has no navigable destination and renders the 'Coming Soon' treatment. Requirements 6.1, 11.6.

projects.name: Scrapco
projects.description: We built a smart scrap management app that makes doorstep scrap collection simple, fast, and hassle-free. It helps users schedule pickups, manage waste efficiently, and promote sustainable recycling — all through an easy-to-use digital platform designed by our software company.

projects.name: GTC
projects.description: We developed a smart GTC management platform that centralizes data from vendors, godowns, and operations into one dashboard. It enables real-time tracking, better decision-making, streamlined workflows, and efficient management — helping scrap businesses improve visibility, control, and overall operational performance.

projects.name: EzDry
projects.description: We built a smart laundry management app that makes doorstep pickup and laundry services seamless. Users can schedule pickups, track orders in real time, and enjoy hassle-free service — while businesses manage operations efficiently through one powerful, easy-to-use platform.

projects.name: Fogg Road Safety And Alert System
projects.description: We developed an intelligent road safety system designed to reduce accidents in foggy conditions. It alerts nearby vehicles in low visibility and uses eye-tracking sensors to detect driver drowsiness, instantly warning the driver to stay awake and drive safely.

projects.name: GurTron
projects.description: We developed a smart school management platform where teachers can create papers, manage academic tasks, and track students' real-time performance. Schools get detailed analytics, progress reports, and insights to monitor learning outcomes and improve educational efficiency.

projects.name: Fleet Management & Transportation at Ease
projects.description: We built an advanced fleet management platform that provides real-time vehicle tracking, fuel efficiency monitoring, zonal insights, driver performance, and operational analytics — all in one dashboard. It helps businesses optimize fleet operations, reduce costs, and improve overall efficiency.

projects.name: Restaurant Management App
projects.description: We developed a smart food tokenization system where customers scan a QR code to order directly from their table. Orders are managed through live token numbers displayed on LED screens, enabling faster pickups, reducing confusion, and improving restaurant operations efficiently.

projects.name: PolicyLens
projects.description: We built PolicyLens, an insurance broker portal that brings clients, policies, renewals, premiums, claims, and commissions together in one clean dashboard. Its smart risk insights automatically flag coverage gaps — like underinsured clients, missing family coverage, or upcoming renewals — so brokers can spot service opportunities and support their customers proactively.
